description: This file is a PHP script that manages the editing of roles within the SuiteCRM system. It initializes Smarty templates, retrieves role data, sets up categories and actions for role permissions, and renders the appropriate template based on the request.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: The Smarty template engine class used for rendering views in SuiteCRM.

classes.description: Model class representing role entities, providing methods like getRoleActions.

classes.name: ACLAction
classes.description: Utility class for handling ACL action categories and setups.

methods.description: Method to retrieve actions associated with a given role.

methods.description: Method to setup a matrix of categories and actions for display.
